title: Non-degeneracy of Killing forms on real conjugacy classes of finite groups
summary: Killing forms on finite groups arise as special cases of braided Killing forms on braided Lie algebras. If $\mathcal{C}$ is a conjugation-stable subset of a finite group $G$, the Killing form on $\mathbb{C}\mathcal{C}$ is given by $K_\mathcal{C}(a,b) = |C_G(ab) \cap \mathcal{C}|$ for $a,b \in \mathcal{C}$. It is conjectured in previous work by López Peña, Majid and Rietsch that $K_\mathcal{C}$ is non-degenerate for any real conjugacy class $\mathcal{C}$ in a finite simple group.
